## Context

`docs/assets/rebar-demo.svg` uses a deprecated four digit ticket reference, an unconditional bare assignee, stale displayed output, and narration that no longer matches the supported workflow. Ticket weak-amenable-worm records the decision to keep this asset static and text-editable.

## Plan

- Replace deprecated references with supported aliases or two-quad identifiers.
- Remove the unconditional explicit assignee from the claim example.
- Align displayed commands, responses, and narration with current CLI contracts.
- Preserve the static SVG implementation without adding a generator.
- Preserve the image role, `aria-label`, and README alternative text mechanisms. Update their wording only where the displayed interaction changes.
- Render and inspect the SVG at normal and narrow display sizes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every displayed ticket reference uses a supported authoring form.
- [ ] The claim example does not require an explicit assignee.
- [ ] Displayed output matches current CLI behavior and punctuation.
- [ ] The narration matches the displayed interaction.
- [ ] The SVG remains static and text-editable.
- [ ] The SVG retains its accessibility label and the README retains alternative text.
- [ ] Rendered normal and narrow views remain legible.

## Testing

- `xmllint --noout docs/assets/rebar-demo.svg`
- `python scripts/check_readme_quickstart.py`
- `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check`
- `git diff --check`
